checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Moon phase", the Illuminated and Age (days) values, and the accuracy note.
Setting the date to 2024-04-08 at 12:00 shows "New Moon" with illumination under 2%.
From 2024-04-15, the Upcoming tab lists a Full Moon on Apr 23, 2024.
The buttons +1 day and -1 day, and the ArrowRight key, move the selected date by one day.
The Month tab shows day cells and tapping a day selects it in the Today panel.
An empty time shows the inline error "Enter a valid time"; a year outside 1900 to 2100 shows an accuracy warning.
Hemisphere and 12 or 24 hour settings persist after reload.
